prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints consistent with cervical whiplash injury. Over the course of seven visits, care followed a conventional and expected progression, beginning with pain control, gentle range-of-motion exercises, and soft tissue management, then tapering in frequency as symptoms improved. Physical examination revealed some objective findings, including reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the reported injury. Other neurological and orthopedic tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding area, and no earlier complaints of this nature are documented in the record. The injury mechanism described is a plausible explanation for the symptoms observed. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries. At the most recent visit, the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
